recipes.name: Mild coconut chicken korma
recipes.method_note: All in one pan. Rice or bread on the side if you like.

steps.instruction: Put a large pan on a medium heat. Add {{ing:vegetable-oil}}.
Chop {{ing:onion-medium}}. Fry 8 minutes, until soft and golden.
Add {{ing:garlic-clove}} and {{ing:curry-powder}} and {{ing:garam-masala}}. Fry 1 minute, until fragrant.
Simmer 20 minutes, stirring now and then, until the chicken is cooked through.

steps.instruction: Put a large pan on a medium heat. Add {{ing:vegetable-oil}}.
Chop {{ing:onion-medium}}. Fry 8 minutes, until soft and golden.
Add {{ing:garlic-clove}} and {{ing:curry-powder}} and {{ing:cumin-ground}}. Fry 1 minute, until fragrant.
Simmer 20 minutes, stirring now and then, until the aubergine is soft.

recipes.name: One-pot tomato and basil pasta
recipes.method_note: The pasta cooks in the sauce, so its starch thickens it. Stir so it does not stick.

steps.instruction: Put a large, deep pan on a medium heat.
Simmer 12 minutes, stirring often, until the pasta is tender and the sauce thick.

recipes.name: One-pot creamy mushroom pasta
recipes.method_note: The pasta cooks in the sauce, so its starch thickens it. Stir so it does not stick.

steps.instruction: Put a large, deep pan on a medium heat.
Add {{ing:mushroom-chestnut}} and {{ing:garlic-clove}}. Fry 4 minutes, until soft.
Simmer 12 minutes, stirring often, until the pasta is tender and the sauce thick.

recipes.name: One-pot sausage, fennel and tomato pasta
recipes.method_note: The pasta cooks in the sauce, so its starch thickens it. Stir so it does not stick.

steps.instruction: Put a large, deep pan on a medium heat.
Add {{ing:sausage-pork}} and {{ing:olive-oil}}. Fry 4 minutes, breaking the sausage out of its skins.
Add {{ing:fennel-seeds}} and {{ing:chilli-flakes}}. Fry 4 minutes, until soft.
Simmer 12 minutes, stirring often, until the pasta is tender and the sauce thick.

recipes.name: One-pot lemon, spinach and ricotta pasta
recipes.method_note: The pasta cooks in the sauce, so its starch thickens it. Stir so it does not stick.

steps.instruction: Put a large, deep pan on a medium heat.
Simmer 12 minutes, stirring often, until the pasta is tender and the sauce thick.
Stir in {{ing:spinach}}, {{ing:ricotta}} and the zest and juice of {{ing:lemon}}.

recipes.name: One-pot tuna and sweetcorn pasta
recipes.method_note: The pasta cooks in the sauce, so its starch thickens it. Stir so it does not stick.

steps.instruction: Put a large, deep pan on a medium heat.
Simmer 12 minutes, stirring often, until the pasta is tender and the sauce thick.
Stir in drained {{ing:tuna-tinned-in-spring-water}} and {{ing:sweetcorn-tinned}}. Top with grated {{ing:cheddar-cheese}}.

steps.instruction: Put a large, deep pan on a medium heat.

recipes.name: Chicken and pepper jambalaya
recipes.method_note: Keep the lid on while it simmers; the steam cooks the rice.

steps.instruction: Put a large, deep pan with a lid on a medium heat.
Add {{ing:onion-medium}}, {{ing:pepper-bell}} and {{ing:celery-stick}}. Fry 8 minutes, until soft.
Rest 5 minutes off the heat. Finish with {{ing:spring-onion}}.

recipes.name: King prawn and pea pilaf
recipes.method_note: Keep the lid on while it simmers; the steam cooks the rice.

steps.instruction: Put a large, deep pan with a lid on a medium heat.
Stir in {{ing:king-prawns-raw}} and {{ing:peas-frozen}}. Cover. Cook 5 minutes, until hot through and the rice is tender.
Rest 5 minutes off the heat. Finish with {{ing:lemon}}.

recipes.name: Mushroom pilau rice
recipes.method_note: Keep the lid on while it simmers; the steam cooks the rice.

steps.instruction: Put a large, deep pan with a lid on a medium heat.
Add {{ing:onion-medium}} and {{ing:mushroom-chestnut}}. Fry 8 minutes, until soft.
Stir in {{ing:garam-masala}} and {{ing:cardamom}} and {{ing:rice-basmati-dry}} for 1 minute.
Rest 5 minutes off the heat. Finish with {{ing:fresh-coriander}}.

recipes.name: Spanish vegetable rice
recipes.method_note: Keep the lid on while it simmers; the steam cooks the rice.

steps.instruction: Put a large, deep pan with a lid on a medium heat.
Add {{ing:onion-medium}}, {{ing:pepper-bell}} and {{ing:courgette}}. Fry 8 minutes, until soft.
Stir in {{ing:smoked-paprika}} and {{ing:saffron}} and {{ing:rice-arborio-dry}} for 1 minute.
Stir in {{ing:peas-frozen}}. Cover. Cook 5 minutes, until hot through and the rice is tender.
Rest 5 minutes off the heat. Finish with {{ing:lemon}}.

recipes.name: Chicken and chorizo rice
recipes.method_note: Keep the lid on while it simmers; the steam cooks the rice.

steps.instruction: Put a large, deep pan with a lid on a medium heat.
Cut {{ing:chorizo}} and {{ing:chicken-thigh-boneless}} into chunks. Brown 6 minutes.
Add {{ing:onion-medium}} and {{ing:pepper-bell}}. Fry 8 minutes, until soft.
Rest 5 minutes off the heat. Finish with {{ing:fresh-parsley}}.

recipes.name: Spiced egg and tomato rice
recipes.method_note: Keep the lid on while it simmers; the steam cooks the rice.

steps.instruction: Put a large, deep pan with a lid on a medium heat.
Make 4 dips in the rice. Crack in {{ing:egg-medium}}. Cover. Cook 5 minutes, until the whites set.
Rest 5 minutes off the heat. Finish with {{ing:fresh-coriander}}.

recipes.name: Black bean and corn rice
recipes.method_note: Keep the lid on while it simmers; the steam cooks the rice.

steps.instruction: Put a large, deep pan with a lid on a medium heat.
Stir in {{ing:black-beans-tinned}} and {{ing:sweetcorn-tinned}}. Cover. Cook 5 minutes, until hot through and the rice is tender.
Rest 5 minutes off the heat. Finish with {{ing:lime}} and {{ing:fresh-coriander}}.

recipes.name: Lemon and herb chicken rice
recipes.method_note: Keep the lid on while it simmers; the steam cooks the rice.

steps.instruction: Put a large, deep pan with a lid on a medium heat.
Add {{ing:onion-medium}} and {{ing:garlic-clove}}. Fry 8 minutes, until soft.
Rest 5 minutes off the heat. Finish with {{ing:lemon}} and {{ing:fresh-parsley}}.
